manual_workbench_slate.name: 🛠️ Manual Workbench (Empty Slate)
manual_workbench_slate.description: Loads the audio waveform, BPM beat/bar grid, and transient markers without auto-cuts (preserving any Pinned blocks) for total hands-on drag-and-drop assembly, edge trimming, and playhead splitting.

narrative_storyboard.name: 🎬 Narrative Storyboard
narrative_storyboard.description: 01/02 chronological spine, 4.0s+ holds, full clip duration preservation, and clean frame-accurate cuts.

lofi_vhs_tape.name: 📼 Lo-Fi VHS Tape Deck
lofi_vhs_tape.description: 2.0s–4.0s cuts, subtle CRT scanlines, tape tracking flicker on snares, and slow nostalgic Ken Burns drift.

cyber_glitch_hyperchop.name: ⚡ Cyber Glitch / Hyper-Chop
cyber_glitch_hyperchop.description: 0.20s–0.45s rapid transient slicing, aggressive RGB channel tear, horizontal slice displacement, and strobe flash.

scene_cluster_montage.name: 🧩 Scene Cluster Montage
scene_cluster_montage.description: Anchors 01_video clips while firing rapid 01_a / 01_b still-image stabs on hi-hat and snare fills.

analog_16mm_film.name: 🎞️ Analog 16mm Film Reel
analog_16mm_film.description: 3.0s–5.0s phrase-locked cuts, animated 16mm film grain overlay, warm halation glow, and subtle gate weave.

dark_minimalist.name: 🌑 Dark Minimalist
dark_minimalist.description: 5.0s–8.0s hypnotic holds, high-contrast shadow crush, and automatic black-frame dropouts on quiet passages.

social_reel_frenzy.name: 🔥 Social Short / Reel Frenzy
social_reel_frenzy.description: Relentless beat-locked cuts (0.35s–1.0s) with hard zoom-punch impacts on every downbeat and snare.

burroughs_cutup_machine.name: ✂️ Burroughs Cut-Up Machine
burroughs_cutup_machine.description: 3-column vertical Fold-In split canvas sequencing streams asynchronously, snare typographic flash injection, and 3-frame kick reverse-stutter.

brakhage_emulsion_decay.name: 🔥 Brakhage Emulsion Decay
brakhage_emulsion_decay.description: Vertical sprocket jumps, hand-scratched celluloid emulsion lines, and organic copper/amber heat burns keyed to bass drops.

structural_flicker_sharits.name: ⚡ Structural Flicker (Sharits / Conrad)
structural_flicker_sharits.description: 1-to-2 frame alternating strobes between adjacent clips and pure black/white frames on cymbal and hi-hat transients.

metric_time_stutter_kubelka.name: 📐 Metric Time-Stutter (Kubelka)
metric_time_stutter_kubelka.description: Strict Fibonacci-ratio frame slicing (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 units) with 3-frame reverse-stutter loops on every downbeat.

lynchian_industrial_monochrome.name: 🏭 Lynchian Industrial Monochrome (Eraserhead)
lynchian_industrial_monochrome.description: Chalk-and-soot high-contrast monochrome, 12fps step-print cadence, sub-bass canvas tremors (20–60Hz), and 1-frame tungsten arc flashes on snares.

mekas_bolex_diary.name: 📽️ Mekas Bolex Diary
mekas_bolex_diary.description: Rapid 2-to-4 frame bursts of stills and clips on transients resolving into lyrical 2.0s–3.0s contemplative holds.

marker_photo_montage_jetee.name: 🖼️ Marker Photo-Montage (La Jetée)
marker_photo_montage_jetee.description: Stills-only sequence holding 3.0s–5.0s across bars, awakening into a single moving video clip at peak track loudness.

debord_detournement.name: ⚖️ Debord Détournement
debord_detournement.description: Dialectical tension: 6.0s–8.0s unbroken shots during high-energy sections vs. rapid staccato cuts during quiet passages.

babalon_working_parsons.name: 🔥 Babalon Working (Parsons / 1946 Mojave)
babalon_working_parsons.description: Saturated desert solar flares, blood-red & gold duotone shifts, heat-shimmer displacement. Strict 7-beat and 11-beat rhythmic intervals with 2-frame solar overexposure blooms & crimson flashes on heavy snares.

chaos_sigil_flash_spare.name: 🜏 Chaos Sigil Flash (Austin Osman Spare / IOT)
chaos_sigil_flash_spare.description: Slices graphic glyphs & stills as 1-frame (16ms) subconscious flashes. Sub-bass impacts and kick transients trigger instant negative/inverted 1-frame sigil injections returning immediately to the ongoing story clip.

enochian_scrying_glass_dee.name: 🔮 Enochian Scrying Glass (Dee & Kelley)
enochian_scrying_glass_dee.description: Dark obsidian vignette falloff and radial mirror reflections. Hypnotic 5.0s–8.0s scrying holds with soft dissolves; cymbal/hi-hat washes trigger faint Enochian angelic character overlays.

typhonian_transmissions_grant.name: 👁️ Typhonian Transmissions (Grant / Outer Gateways)
typhonian_transmissions_grant.description: Deep cosmic voids, inverted negative stroboscopic pulses, and erratic radio-frequency static glitches keyed to unpredictable transient spikes from beyond the Mauve Zone.

dim_carcosa_aldebaran_gold.name: 👑 Dim Carcosa / Aldebaran Gold
dim_carcosa_aldebaran_gold.description: Tarnished metallic gold, deep amber, and atmospheric dust haze. Slow, unhurried structural long takes alternating with sudden, jarring geometric match-cuts on downbeats.
